targetInterpretation: Stable 140 and stable 150 are evaluated separately by their threshold fractions; no human mastery inference.
promotion: Keep as explicit experimental option. No default or model-weight replacement.
confidence: 95% bootstrap interval over complete independent seed groups, 10000 draws. Mixed human compared with baseline-all at matching seed and seat.
sourceFreeze: Benchmark hashes all computational source files and immutable weights before and after running; refuse changed runs. No tuning on holdout seeds.
